sections_in_source.heading: 分部 A SUNDAY IN MAY
sections_in_source.note: 源文本中未出现该小标题字样；源文本只有 The Police Station 一个显式标题 + 四处 * * * 分隔段

beats.what: 泡绿茶（绿茶放在自己桌上/柜子里「kept it in his locker for his own personal usage in desperate situations」），听 Foreign Office 说领事联系不上 Fenella Combe-Watson（她去参加灵性静修、没给旅馆留信息），怕她从「third cousin's Facebook post」得知消息，于是放 Matt 的 jungle playlist，播放对面广场的门铃摄像头录像
beats.verbatim_snippet: He started playing Matt’s most exulted jungle playlist and pressed play on the doorbell cam footage from across the square.

beats.what: 因为 Barry 说死亡发生在 7 p.m.–9 p.m. 之间，所以从 2 p.m. 起以双倍速回看，只截图「走向 Horatio Combe Institute」的人；能看到轮廓、身高体格、穿戴携带物
beats.verbatim_snippet: Barry had said that the death occurred somewhere between 7 p.m. and 9 p.m., so he began watching from 2 p.m. on double speed, screenshotting anyone walking towards the Horatio Combe Institute.

beats.what: 看到 Willow 如她所述往返、抱着一本书离开，暂无可疑人；随后（看过 6.30 p.m. 之后、音乐第三次循环时）看到一名穿 oversized cardigan + 深色宽松牛仔裤、深色波波头的女人，长得极像实习生 Willow Bell
beats.verbatim_snippet: a woman wearing an oversized cardigan and a pair of dark, baggy jeans. Her dark hair was cropped into a bob. She looked remarkably like Willow Bell, the intern.

beats.what: 把空的文件夹「砰」地放桌上（里面什么都没有，只是要让 Willow 以为里面有东西），重走一遍正式流程，把 Willow 叫回警局短通知问话
beats.verbatim_snippet: He put a large folder on the table. It thudded ominously. There wasn’t anything in the folder, but he wanted Willow to think there was.

beats.what: 问 Willow 周五 6.30 p.m. 左右在哪；听到她说在 Harpenden 父母家、父亲周五退休、cricket club 办派对、她从 St Pancras 坐火车、周六早上八点前被母亲送到车站后，问她身高，得到「Five foot two」，随即暂停问话去走廊问 Amy 身高，得到「Five foot five」，并让 Tiny Simm 在同一地点给 Amy 拍照、等 5 分钟发来
beats.verbatim_snippet: She was diminutive. ‘Willow, how tall are you?’ … ‘Five foot two.’ … ‘Five foot five.’

beats.what: 问 Willow 是否有狂热粉丝（DMs、亲自出现），并指出「Isolde 冒用身份」的可能；Caius 说「There’s no evidence to suggest so」但让她注意异常者并来电；同时把前一天找到的 Isolde 的信交 forensics 做指纹与信封唾液检测
beats.verbatim_snippet: Caius had given the letters from Isolde that he’d found yesterday to forensics to fingerprint and to test the envelopes for saliva.

beats.what: Amy 回到警局，Caius 把门铃摄像头截图与 Tiny Simm 拍的同地点的 Amy 照片并排比较，说这个人比 Willow 高几英寸、比 Amy 也高几英寸；Caius 认为是「prank」，但代价太大（设 PO Box、连续数周写信给 Digby）；提出「Willow 的前男友」假设，Willow 否认并说已把对方甩了（Ex），Tom 是海洋生物学家，在 Cornwall 跟导师追踪 basking sharks 待了八个月，在 Penzance，不可能安排这种事
beats.verbatim_snippet: ‘You’re a couple of inches taller than Willow and this person is a couple of inches taller than you,’

beats.what: 在 Willow 面前展示截图问她认不认识，Willow 说画面很 grainy、可能只是广场居民；问话结束后 Willow 交出指纹以便从犯罪现场排除，Caius 建议她回 Harpenden 父母家住一段时间；Amy 把模糊截图钉到事件板上用记号笔写上『Isolde?』；Caius 说除她之外没人在约定时间走向 Institute（『appointed time for the date』），并称另有 10 人在 Digby 死前两小时走过；分析：Isolde 装扮成「最可能发现尸体的人」，若有人在外面盯着房子（邻居或抗议者），大概只会看到一个深色波波头和巨大开衫，有身高差但从广场对面瞥一眼可能会当成 Willow 晚班；判断 Isolde 必须已经盯着 Institute 一阵子了；Amy 补充 Willow 说自己很小心不泄露行踪，且提到
；Caius 说要再去定位 Isolde 离开的录像
beats.verbatim_snippet: Isolde dressed up as the person who they likely knew would find the body.

numbers_and_dates_verbatim.verbatim: Barry had said that the death occurred somewhere between 7 p.m. and 9 p.m.
so he began watching from 2 p.m. on double speed
He had watched up to 6.30 p.m.
Matt’s playlist had looped around to ‘Incredible’ by M-Beat and General Levy for a third time
‘Willow, where were you Friday evening at around 6.30 p.m.?’
My dad retired on Friday. We had a big party at the cricket club to celebrate that evening.
I caught the train from St Pancras mid-afternoon after I’d picked up my book for my essay. My mum dropped me off at the station before eight o’clock on Saturday morning.
I have six of this specific cardigan, in different colours, and twenty-two others. Practically one for each day of the month.
I have three pairs of the same shoes in different leathers.
then waited five minutes for them to send it over
I’m really popular in Taiwan. I’m the rainbow cardigan girl.
Setting up a PO Box and corresponding with Digby by letter for weeks.
He’s been in Cornwall for the last eight months with his tutor tracking basking sharks.
It might have just been one slip-up on a story six weeks ago.
I’ve got screenshots of ten other people who walked past in the two hours before Digby’s death that aren’t a priority any more.
No one else walked towards the Institute at the appointed time for the date.
